name: Mr. Spoonatelli's House of Spoons
description: An old-world spoon emporium that has completely lost control of its inventory: walnut cabinetry, emerald velvet with a damask of tiny spoons, spoons stabbed into every edge and strewn across the panels (fancy, rusted, and carved with warnings about the forbidden fourth spoon), a swaying spoon rack, spoon-bowl knobs, a serving-ladle volume knob, the founder's portrait, and a corkboard that can't agree whether the fourth spoon is a lie.
